newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL noon rubber mixed on Tokyo, watches ringgit.
newsitem.headline: KL noon rubber mixed on Tokyo, watches ringgit.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices was mixed at midday in tandem with the futures market in Tokyo, and producers were watching the ringgit closely to see if further price adjustments had to be made, traders said.
There were no inquiries or business heard for the day and nearby direction was dependent on the strength of the ringgit, said traders.
"There's hardly anything happening for the moment and everyone is just watching the currency," said a trader.
At midday, the RSS1 for September buyer was officially quoted at 249.50 cents (95 U.S.cents) a kg, unchanged from Monday's close.
The SMR20 for September buyer was at 248, down half cent from Monday.
Dealers offered SMR CV at 293 cents, SMR L at 275, SMR 5 at 253, SMR 10 at 247 and SMR 20 at 245 and latex at 190.
Malaysia-based shipping brokers quoted freight rates for rubber from Malaysia to Rotterdam at $700 per 20-ft container, and $1,400 per 40-ft container.
